title: Trump’s Economy Pitch Falls Flat With Voters Ahead of Midterms
title_cn: 特朗普的经济宣传在中期选举前与选民失之交臂
summary: For most of his second term, President Donald Trump has been arguing that the “golden age” he promised for America’s economy is already here. There’s hardly been much evidence that voters agreed.

title: Farage Wins By-Election But Count Binface Gets 26.7% Of Vote
title_cn: 法拉奇赢得补选，但宾法斯伯爵获得 26.7% 的选票
summary: Nigel Farage is returning to Parliament after a comfortable election win over a satirical candidate dressed as a trash can, but the victory is unlikely to quiet questions about the Reform UK leader's personal finances. Farage got 62.8% of the vote in the constituency centered on the English resort town of Clacton-on-Sea to retain his seat in the House of Commons, beating his main competitor, Count Binface. The perennial joke candidate, who poses as an intergalactic space warrior, received a personal-best 26.7%, leading 33 challengers. It was the largest-ever field in a British by-election, as fringe figures flocked to take part in the spectacle. Our Uk Politics Reporter James Woolcock joins Stephen Carroll and Lizzy Burden on Bloomberg Radio to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
